articles.title: The Mona Lisa Was Stolen?! A New Musical Is Coming!
articles.summary: Imagine the world's most famous painting just… gone! In 1911, a worker swiped the Mona Lisa from the Louvre. Now composer Andrew Lloyd Webber is turning this crazy true story into a musical.

articles.title: 36-Year-Old Tennis Star Wins Every Single Game!
articles.summary: Sorana Cirstea, a 36-year-old tennis player who plans to retire soon, just pulled off a "double bagel"—winning 6-0, 6-0—at the French Open. She's the oldest player ever to do that in a Grand Slam!

articles.title: Baby Birds with Mohawks Win Big Photo Prize!
articles.summary: Three fluffy egret chicks look like tiny punk rockers with spiky hairdos. This hilarious photo just won the grand prize in Smithsonian Magazine's photo contest, beating 17,000 other entries!
